conclusions: Actual import resolves packaged dist ES module; no upstream declarations, local d.ts is a restricted adapter
No destroy/dispose, one constructor per isolated document; parent discards entire realm, refresh changes content within existing chart
readonly does not suppress document mouseup registration; DOM replacement is not a disposer
SVG task.name uses innerHTML independently of popup, so toChartTasks escapes text on copied descriptors only
SDK mutates id spaces and uses ordinary-object dependency_map; entry allows restricted ASCII IDs and rejects Object.prototype own names
Default infinite_padding is true; entry explicitly disables it and restricts views to Day/Week/Month
Actual SDK headless setup/date methods prove padded lower/upper calendar arithmetic only; no DOM/chart/listener PASS
SDK uses local date constructors; application span policy is UTC civil-day arithmetic, not a UTC-rendering promise
